summary: Suzano S.A., a Brazilian pulp and paper company, filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, announcing the resignation of Executive Vice President of Pulp Industrial Operations, Engineering and Energy, Mr. Aires Galhardo, effective August 28, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the appointment of Mr. Carlos Aníbal Fernandes de Almeida Júnior, a 23-year company veteran, to succeed him while retaining oversight of Procurement, Certification Strategy, and Futuragene. The filing is a routine executive transition notice, not a takeover, tender, or restructuring event. No deal terms, premiums, or advisors are disclosed. What to watch: operational continuity under the new executive and any succession-related strategy shifts.
